instruction:
Buck regulator heat-spreader clamp package. The desktop contains `/home/user/Desktop/board_input.kicad_pcb`, `/home/user/Desktop/mechanical_requirements.json`, `/home/user/Desktop/connector_keepouts.csv`, `/home/user/Desktop/enclosure_seed.scad`, and `/home/user/Desktop/handoff_notes.md`. The handoff notes are supplementary and cannot override the KiCad board, requirements JSON, or connector CSV. KiCad-derived JSON, CSV, and SCAD handoffs may be generated by a deterministic parser within the KiCad stage; kicad-cli must also successfully load and export the board before OpenSCAD consumes those handoffs, but no particular helper script name or ordering between those KiCad-stage operations is required. Complete this CLI-only engineering handoff with the real software sequence KiCad -> OpenSCAD -> FreeCAD -> Blender. Treat the KiCad board as authoritative for the board outline, thickness, footprint centers, mounting-hole axes, component heights, and keepout radii; treat the requirements JSON as authoritative for package placement, clamp/lid geometry, clearances, tolerances, and material; and treat the connector CSV as authoritative for aperture direction and finished size.

Use the PCB outline center as XY origin. Z=0 is the package bottom outer face and Z increases toward the covering lid. Build the required 117.2 x 75.2 x 18.6 mm PA12 package with 2.6 mm base/lid/side walls, seat the PCB bottom at Z=3.8 mm on four bored standoffs aligned to MH1-MH4, and retain at least 4 mm PCB-to-inner-wall clearance away from apertures. A real covering lid is required. Center a real 6 x 6 mm U1 thermal contact column on U1: its lower face must have a non-negative gap of at most 0.1 mm to the nominal U1 body top, and the solid must continue to the lid inner face; it may be integral with the lid or a separate installed part. Keep the full L1 interior keepout cylinder empty: use the KiCad L1 center and `KEEPOUT_RADIUS_MM`, from the nominal PCB top to the covering lid inner face; the lid above its inner face remains required. Measure C1 clearance from the nominal C1 body top to the nearest installed clamp/lid material covering any part of the KiCad C1 keepout-radius region and require at least 2.4 mm; deleting the lid is not a clearance solution. J1 must form a bounded continuous opening through the X_MINUS wall and J2 through the X_PLUS wall, using the CSV finished width/height and the requirements overcut, with the required guard material around every edge. Calculate package volume/mass, side clearance, C1 clearance, U1 contact gap, L1 keepout intrusion, and unintended interference from submitted geometry rather than copying declared values. In Blender, preserve actual package/PCB/component objects; visibly mark the J1 path, J2 path, L1 keepout, C1 clearance, and U1 contact as independently identifiable mesh overlays; save the native scene; and render the review image.

Produce every required artifact directly on the desktop:
- `01_kicad_board.kicad_pcb`
- `01_kicad_board.step`
- `01_kicad_export.json`
- `01_kicad_mechanical_map.csv`
- `01_kicad_parameters.scad`
- `02_openscad_enclosure.scad`
- `02_openscad_enclosure.stl`
- `02_openscad_parameters.json`
- `03_freecad_assembly.step`
- `03_freecad_assembly.obj`
- `03_freecad_clearance_report.json`
- `04_blender_review.blend`
- `04_blender_review.obj`
- `04_blender_review.mtl`
- `04_blender_review.png`
- `04_blender_scene_report.json`
- `toolchain_invocation_log.json`
- `final_release_package.json`

The artifacts must form a verifiable handoff chain: KiCad must load the board, export `01_kicad_board.step`, and derive the CSV/JSON/SCAD parameter handoffs; OpenSCAD must consume `01_kicad_parameters.scad` and render the submitted STL; FreeCAD must consume the KiCad STEP, OpenSCAD STL, and `02_openscad_parameters.json`, then export a real solid STEP assembly plus `03_freecad_assembly.obj`; Blender must consume that OBJ and the clearance report and save/export/render the final scene. The FreeCAD report must include geometry-derived `package_volume_mm3`, `package_mass_g`, `minimum_side_clearance_mm`, `unintended_interference_volume_mm3`, `c1_clamp_clearance_mm`, `l1_keepout_intersection_mm3`, `u1_contact_gap_mm`, and `decision`. Extra report fields and extra artifacts are allowed. `toolchain_invocation_log.json` must record actual commands, versions, inputs, and outputs; retries and auxiliary calls are allowed. `final_release_package.json` must include every required artifact and report pass only when the geometry-derived checks pass. [Software] Use `kicad-cli` or KiCad scripting, `openscad`, `FreeCADCmd`/`freecadcmd`, and `blender --background --python` in that order. For this task, use `/usr/bin/kicad-cli`, `/usr/bin/openscad`, `/home/user/.local/bin/freecadcmd`, and `/snap/bin/blender` for the four stages, in that order.
